# Shared HarmonyOS foundation test sources

These AGPL-3.0-or-later sources are a snapshot of the jide_foundation 0.2.16 implementation used by the app. The Node regression suite executes the shared rendering and geometry logic from this snapshot so a clean checkout and the public source export can run without the sibling DevEco project. When upgrading the HAR, refresh the matching source files here and run the repository and export checks.
